name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Markdown knowledge base with team workspaces, offline PWA support, MySQL storage and an S3-compatible file store.

alerts.message: Sign-up is open and new accounts are regular users. To get the admin panel, copy your user ID from the profile page (enable developer mode in settings), set ADMIN_ACCOUNTS to it and redeploy. Set CONFIG_DISABLE_SIGNUP to true to close registrations.

Uploaded files are served from the cdn. subdomain of your app domain, kept separate from the app for security. When you use your own domain, point cdn.<your domain> to the server too, or images and attachments will not load.
HTTPS is required; login cookies are marked Secure and the app calls its API and file store over https://, so a plain HTTP domain will not work.
